context:
Confidential C
Efficiency: V2I optimizes traffic flow. A cyberattack disrupting adaptive traffic
management systems (impacting Availability and Integrity) would lead to massive
congestion and economic losses. Privacy: V2I systems, like smart parking or electronic tolling, collect sensitive vehicle
and driver data. Breaching this data's Confidentiality could expose personal travel
patterns or financial information. Robust cybersecurity, encompassing Authentication, Authorization, Accounting, and
ensuring Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability, is crucial for V2I's safe, reliable,
and trustworthy operation, preventing chaos and maintaining public confidence in
intelligent transportation systems.
spoofing or jamming could mislead the vehicle, compromising safety. 7b. Vision Technology
Vision technology allows autonomous vehicles to "see" and understand their
surroundings. It integrates data from:
•
Cameras: Provide rich visual data for object classification, lane detection, and
traffic sign recognition, though sensitive to lighting. •
LiDAR: Generates precise 3D point clouds for accurate depth and obstacle
detection, effective in varying light. •
Radar: Excels in adverse weather for long-range detection and velocity
measurement. Sensor fusion combines these inputs for a comprehensive and
robust environmental perception. Cybersecurity concerns include adversarial
attacks that can trick AI perception or jamming of sensors, leading to dangerous
misinterpretations.

inject malicious data into other connected vehicle systems. MOST Architecture
•
MOST is designed to connect various multimedia devices within an automotive
network. •
It allows for both synchronous and asynchronous data transmission, which is
crucial for real-time audio and video. •
Communication typically occurs over Fiber optic cables, which contributes to its
high speed and immunity to electromagnetic interference.
